narr: Late afternoon thunderstorm activity pushed off the Palmer Divide moving east-southeast across the Colorado plains. Numerous flash flooding events, severe thunderstorm winds and some damage were reported across the region.
ev: Flooding over Highway 50 in spots between Reynolds Ave and CR 24.
Colorado DOT reports flooding on Highway 50 near mile marker 394 (between county road 5.5 and county road 6.25).
lsr: FLOODING OVER HIGHWAY 50 IN SPOTS BETWEEN REYNOLDS AVE AND CR 24.
CDOT REPORTS FLOODING ON HIGHWAY 50 BETWEEN COUNTY ROAD 5.5 AND COUNTY ROAD 6.25 (APPROXIMATELY 1 WEST OF LAS ANIMAS AREA).
